# Sanad Platform - LLM Context & Architecture Specification
# Format: /llms.txt (Machine-Readable Context for Generative Search Engines and AI Agents)
# Canonical URL: https://sanad.app/llms.txt

## Executive Summary
Sanad (سند) is a verified-scholars-only social, educational, and live streaming platform designed to preserve authentic traditional Islamic sciences through classical chain-of-transmission (Isnad) methodology. Only accredited and peer-vetted scholars possess posting and halaqah livestreaming privileges; general members participate through structured inquiry, learning, and engagement.

## Architecture & Technical Stack
- Monorepo: npm workspaces monorepo (@sanad/shared, @sanad/api, sanad-mobile).
- Mobile & Web: Expo SDK 58, React Native 0.88, Expo Router, strict TypeScript, react-native-safe-area-context.
- Backend API: Node.js v22, Express, TypeScript, Mongoose (MongoDB), IORedis, Pino structured logging, Helmet security headers.
- Design Foundation: 60:30:10 palette (60% Ivory #F8F5EE, 30% Emerald #0F4C45, 10% Gold #C9A227).
- Realtime Media: Socket.io with Redis clustering, LiveKit short-lived role-scoped tokens (host canPublish, viewer subscribe-only).

## Core Non-Negotiables & Platform Policies
1. Verified-Scholars-Only Publishing: General members cannot create top-level feed posts or host live streams.
2. Anti-Takfir & Dignity Standard: Zero tolerance for declarations of apostasy, hate speech, sectarian vitriol, or unreferenced rulings.
3. Cryptographic Token Hygiene: 15-minute access JWTs, 30-day rotating refresh tokens with SHA-256 hash persistence, immediate session-family revocation on reuse detection.
4. Strict Age Compliance: Users must be 13 years or older (validated by ISO-8601 Date of Birth schema checks).
5. Mandatory Scholar 2FA: RFC 6238 TOTP two-factor authentication enforced for all scholar, moderator, and admin accounts.

## Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) Matrix
- guest: Read-only access to public feeds, reels, and profiles.
- member: Like, bookmark, request scholarly chats, submit scholar credential dossier, submit reports.
- scholar: Create posts, reels, video masterclasses, schedule & host live halaqahs, initiate 1:1 calls, manage comments.
- moderator: Review incoming triage queues (P0/P1/P2), issue warnings, temporary suspensions, remove offending content.
- admin: Final approval of scholar applications, assign/revoke roles, access immutable audit logs, platform configuration.
